business_problem: Penske Logistics needed to replace brittle on-prem reporting systems with a scalable data and AI foundation so leaders could analyze years of operational data, improve safety and retention decisions, and finally make generative AI projects practical inside a secure enterprise environment.
solution_summary: Penske moved performance and operational data onto Snowflake on Azure and used Cortex AI to turn that centralized data into manager-ready insights. Snowflake became the shared platform for five years of companywide reporting, freeing analysts from manual report production and letting teams use Tableau for self-service exploration. On top of that foundation, Penske deployed Cortex AI inside Snowflake’s governed perimeter so managers could summarize nearly 30 columns of associate performance indicators into concise talking points and recommendations without moving data to outside AI services. This combined architecture gives Penske repeatable reporting and model workflows while business users consume secure AI outputs directly in their tools. It improved reporting speed, unlocked safer and more informed conversations with associates, and gave Penske a practical, low-friction path to extend AI into other operations such as sentiment analysis and document extraction.

business_outcome: Penske can build new AI summarization models in under 15 days, produce five-year reports in 15 minutes, and give managers clearer performance insights that improve productivity, retention, and safety while reducing the friction of adopting enterprise generative AI.

evidence_quotes: With Snowflake on Azure, Penske Logistics has centralized data in a secure environment, scaled its infrastructure to improve performance, and immediately improved its reporting capabilities.
Now, business analysts create BI reports with companywide data spanning five years in just 15 minutes.
Because it hosts and serves large language models (LLMs) within Snowflake’s governed perimeter, Cortex AI made it easy and cost-effective for the team to securely bring LLMs to their data
Now, Penske uses LLMs in Cortex AI to process performance indicators in record time and produce relative talking points and recommendations for each associate.
